# ANALYSIS: VIX threshold sweep (15-25) for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON

**Filed:** 2026-07-13  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that adjusting the VIX confirmation threshold within the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup (currently VIX rising OR already above 20) to a sweep of values from 15 to 25 may improve edge capture on J's anchor days by better aligning with regime-specific volatility conditions, while avoiding overfitting to a single threshold.

## Mechanism

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup includes a VIX confirmation filter: for puts, VIX should be rising OR already above 20 at time of entry. We will replace the fixed threshold of 20 with a parameter sweep of integer values from 15 to 25 inclusive. For each threshold value, we will run a walk-forward out-of-sample (OOS) backtest using real OPRA fills (via `simulator_real.py`) on the full available history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18), compute edge_capture on J's anchor days, and calculate aggregate Sharpe. The sweep will be evaluated for monotonicity and robustness across sub-windows.
